overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the June 18 notice topic on shellfish cultching permitting was sufficiently specific, and a presentation need not be listed separately on the notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the June 18 notice topic on shellfish cultching permitting was not specific enough to show expansion would be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Here, sufficient detail was included in the notice for the June 18 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice should have listed that a shellfish constable would give a presentation at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, there is no universal requirement within the Open Meeting Law that any time discussion of an anticipated topic will include a presentation, the presentation itself must be listed on the notice.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
